axes: world metres, glTF: +X east, north = -Z. row 0 = north edge (zmin), col 0 = west edge (xmin)
cell_centre: x = xmin + (col + 0.5) * res ; z = zmin + (row + 0.5) * res

classes.name: ground
classes.desc: open land: sidewalks, quays, plazas, empty lots, far-shore land, park paths

classes.name: landmark
classes.desc: named landmark tower (Empire, Chrysler, Freedom, Billionaires' Row)

classes.name: base
classes.desc: hero base (Tony's villa, Peter's apartment building)

height: metres = value * 2 (max building height in the cell; 0 for open ground/water)
png_channels: R = class, G = height/2, B = district, A = 255 — sample with NEAREST filtering
